page: Microsoft Azure M176ds_4_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the MDSMediumMemoryv3 family. Built on Microsoft Hyper-V, the instance features an Intel x86_64 processor delivering 176 dedicated vCPUs. It is provisioned with 3,892.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 22.11 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is not present, with zero GPUs allocated.

For local disk operations, the instance includes 429 GB of local SSD storage and supports Premium Storage integration. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The hardware configuration emphasizes a high memory-to-core allocation rather than large local ephemeral disk arrays.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high memory density allows consolidating sprawling enterprise workloads onto a single node, which reduces network complexity between distributed nodes. A trade-off is the relatively small local SSD volume relative to the massive memory capacity, requiring external persistent storage for durable data sets. The architecture is suited for in-memory databases, large-scale enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-intensive analytics.
